name: schema-invalid-then-success
why: A response whose text is not JSON at all, then a clean one.

provenance.why_not_recorded: `output_config.format` constrains the response to the schema, so the API is not supposed to return prose here. The branch is the defence against that constraint failing, and a constraint failing on demand is not something a caller can order.

content.text: I'm happy to help! Here are the pages:
